description: This file defines a Context class for managing browser contexts, tabs, routes, and video recordings in Playwright testing framework. It includes configuration types, route management, tab handling, and utility functions for file handling.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages a Playwright browser context, including tabs, routes, videos, and configuration.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all resources, including tabs and video recordings.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns the list of current tabs.

methods.name: currentTab
methods.description: Returns the current active tab.

methods.name: currentTabOrDie
methods.description: Returns the current tab or throws if none is available.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates and returns a new tab.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab by index.

methods.name: ensureTab
methods.description: Ensures a tab exists, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a tab by index or current.

methods.name: workspaceFile
methods.description: Resolves a workspace file path.

methods.name: outputFile
methods.description: Generates an output file path based on a template.

methods.name: startVideoRecording
methods.description: Starts recording video for the context.

methods.name: stopVideoRecording
methods.description: Stops video recording and returns recorded videos.

methods.name: _startPageVideo
methods.description: Starts video recording for a page.

methods.name: _onPageCreated
methods.description: Handles new page creation.

methods.name: _onPageClosed
methods.description: Handles page closure.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Returns current route entries.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a new route.

methods.name: removeRoute
methods.description: Removes route(s) by pattern.

methods.name: isRunningTool
methods.description: Checks if a tool is running.

methods.name: setRunningTool
methods.description: Sets the name of the running tool.

methods.name: lookupSecret
methods.description: Retrieves a secret value or code.
